steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Your Party Bar
steps.body:
See those hero cards at the bottom of the screen? That's your Party Bar. It shows every hero in your active party at a glance — their stats, health, and equipment.

You can manage everything about your party right from there.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Gear Management
steps.body: Click the Gear button on any hero card to equip weapons, armor, and accessories. You can also equip a backpack in the Bag slot to carry more items into the dungeon.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Row Formations
steps.body:
Below the Gear button you'll see three position buttons — F, M, and B — for Front, Middle, and Back rows.

Melee enemies target your Front row first, so put your toughest fighters there. But beware — ranged enemies can target any row and will pick off your weakest hero. Keep everyone healthy, not just your front line.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Before You Go
steps.body:
Beyond the basics like Attack and Defense, look out for Evasion (dodge chance), Crit (bonus damage), Resist (reduces magic damage), Thorns (hurts melee attackers), Armor Penetration (ignores defense), and Life Steal (heals on hit). Fill hero bags with consumables before heading out.

Visit the Shop for healing potions, weapons, and armor. What's available depends on your facility tiers and unlocked recipes, so invest in upgrades when you can. Good luck out there, Shopkeeper!
